Contract ManageCashDeskCRUDService::queryCashDesk(id: Integer): CashDesk {
	definition:
		cashDesks: Set(CashDesk) = CashDesk.allInstance(),
		selectedCashDesk: CashDesk = cashDesks->any(desk|desk.Id = id)
	precondition:
		cashDesks->exists(desk|desk.Id = id)
	postcondition:
		selectedCashDesk.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		result = selectedCashDesk
}
